page.layout: One column of running text with short numbered sections. Marginal italic catchwords stand in the left margin beside each section. A vertical spine label runs down the left margin. Running head at top centre, page number at top left.

main_text.p: Conditio Facta est vltima eorum conditio deterior priore. 2. Pet. 2,20.
Scripturæ S. depravatio In Epistolis Pauli nonnulli sunt difficilia intellectu, quæ indocti parumque stabiles detorquent, vt & reliquas scripturas, suo ipsorum exitio. 2. Pet. 3,16.

Antichristianismus Quicunq; spiritus non confitetur Christum in carne venisse, ex Deo non est, sed hic est ille Spiritus Antichristi, de quo audistis eum venturum fuisse, & iam nunc in mundo esse. 1. Joh. 4,3.
Antiesuitismus[?] Multi impostores ingressi sunt in mundum; qui non confitentur Iesum Christum venisse in carne. Qui est eiusmodi, impostor est & Antichristus. 2. Joh. 7.

p.i: Dogmata & mores Hæc graphice depinguntur in epistola S. Iuda, cuius testimonia quoniam consentiunt cum iis quæ citavimus ex 2. Pet. c. 4. iterum adscribere nolui.

main_text.p: Noxia concursationes Ex fumo putei abyssi exierunt locustæ in terram: datæque est illis po-testas quale habent terrestres scorpii. Apoc. 9,3.
Furiosa audacia Vidi equos per visionem: & ipsorum fessores habentes thoraces igneos & hyacin-[?]

page.notes: Spine label at far left reads IESUITÆ (vertical, read from the scan); transcribed in the first note of the section beside it is omitted from main text, as it is a margin label. Marginal catchword "Antiesuitismus" is doubtful. Final line "hyacin-" is cut off at the page edge; the end of the word is not visible. The page number "38" is set in an old form and may be read differently.
